## About
A & B Auto Repair Center does complete auto body repair and painting in Los Angeles. Our work covers collision repair, auto body repair, auto restoration, custom paint and custom design.
After a collision you don't always see the full extent of the damage. There can be more behind the bumper, so we check and repair the car back to its factory specifications, then finish it with a fresh coat of factory specified paint.
We work with all insurance companies and can help arrange a rental car while your vehicle is with us. Come by the shop for an estimate and to see the work we're doing on other vehicles.

## Services
- Collision repair: Collision damage often goes deeper than it looks. We check what's behind the bumper and repair the car back to its factory specifications.
- Auto body repair: Whatever body part of the car it is, we repair it and bring the car back to its factory state. We take the time the details need.
- Custom paint: After body repairs, a fresh coat of factory specified paint, so the car looks the way it did when it first rolled out of the dealer.
- Auto restoration: Restoration work as part of our body and paint services.
- Custom design: Customization and custom design work alongside our custom paint.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with all insurance companies.

Q: Can you help me get a rental car?
A: Yes. We can help arrange a rental car for you while we're working on your vehicle.

Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: Come by the shop on San Pedro St and we'll give you an estimate for the work your vehicle needs. You can also call us or send a message through the contact form.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're open Monday through Friday and closed Saturday and Sunday.
